privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'demodb' database contains a 'Profile' class for users and a 'HasFriend' edge class. The profile 'domi@nek.gov' (Isaac Black) and 'seari@ubu.edu' (Rosie Thornton) are pre-seeded. To create a friendship, the agent must create a graph edge of class 'HasFriend' where the 'out' (source) is domi@nek.gov and the 'in' (target) is seari@ubu.edu. This is typically done via the 'Graph' tab or the 'SQL Command' tab using: CREATE EDGE HasFriend FROM (SELECT FROM Profile WHERE Email = 'domi@nek.gov') TO (SELECT FROM Profile WHERE Email = 'seari@ubu.edu').
